title: Climate Analog Search Tools
text: analogs package provides fast, flexible tools climate analog analyses. efficiently searches large reference datasets find locations best match query sites based climate similarity geographic proximity.

title: Climate Analog Search Tools
text: package supports range analysis types. core workhorse function analog_search(), implements various methods selecting summarizing analogs query location. Common query types supported via simplified wrapper functions: analog_impact() predicts ecological state variables using analog impact models (AIMs) analog_velocity() finds k nearest geographic analogs hard climate constraint analog_similarity() finds k nearest climate analogs within geographic constraint analog_availability() counts analogs meet climate distance thresholds analog_intensity() computes distance-weighted aggregations analog properties analog_regression() fits climatically /geographically weighted regressions

title: Climate impact assessment via analog impact model — analog_impact
text: function implements "reverse analog" approach climate change ecology literature. addresses question, "location's future climate, ecological conditions exist current locations similar climates within dispersal range?" methodology: focal location's future climate conditions Find current locations similar climates (within max_clim) Constrain dispersal-reachable distance (within max_geog) Weight analog climate similarity (via weight function) Aggregate ecosystem characteristics across weighted analogs Unlike traditional AIM implementations select k nearest climate neighbors, function uses analogs within thresholds combined climate-distance-based weighting. approach eliminates arbitrary choice k, provides smoother, continuous results, lets weight function (via theta) naturally control influence. (Note traditional version can implemented via analog_search(select = "knn_clim", stat = "mean", ...)).)

title: Climate impact assessment via analog impact model — analog_impact
text: max_geog: Set based species dispersal ability (e.g., 5-500 km) max_clim: Defines counts "analog" theta: Controls weight decay. weight decay small value max_clim/max_geog boundary. theta large relative thresholds, hard cutoffs filtering weighting becomes nearly uniform. Gaussian weights three fewer climate variables, reasonable rule thumb set theta max_* / 3.

title: Climate impact assessment via analog impact model — analog_impact
text: count: many analogs exist within max_clim max_geog? Low counts indicate limited analog availability, zero counts indicate climates novel within geographic search radius. sum_weights: Total analog intensity. Low values indicate sparse distant climate matches. metric captures number quality analogs. Interpretation details vary based weight parameter. weighted_mean: Expected ecosystem state colonized species analog locations.

title: Local weighted regression across analog neighborhoods — analog_regression
text: Fits weighted local regression values covariates within focal location's analog neighborhood. Analog neighborhoods defined climatic similarity, geographic proximity, , covariates capture additional predictors influence outcomes within neighborhood captured search dimensions. generalizes weighted mean — averages within-neighborhood variation — resolving variation driven auxiliary predictors. Supports ordinary ridge-penalized weighted least squares. purely geographic neighborhoods, equivalent geographically weighted regression (GWR); climate-based neighborhoods, extends analog impact model (AIM) framework incorporate local covariate effects.

text: focal location, function: Selects analog pool locations based select, max_clim, max_geog, k Computes distance-based weights analog (via weight theta) Fits weighted least squares regression values covariates using weights, optional ridge penalty lambda Returns regression coefficients (intercept + slopes) math: beta = (X'WX + lambda * I_p)^{-1} X'Wy, W diagonal weights, X design matrix (intercept + covariates), I_p penalizes covariate coefficients (intercept).

Radius units specified kilometers coord_type = "lonlat", projected coordinate units coord_type = "projected". select Character string specifying analog selection strategy. One : "" (default): Select analogs satisfy max_clim max_geog constraints. "knn_clim": focal, select k analogs smallest climate distance, subject filters. "knn_geog": focal, select k analogs smallest geographic distance, subject filters. k Number nearest analogs return per focal location kNN selection modes. Required select "knn_geog" "knn_clim"; must NULL select = "". stat Statistic(s) used aggregate selected analogs. Either: NULL "none": Return selected analog pairs data.frame. "count": focal, count number selected analogs. "sum_weights": focal, sum weights selected analogs (see weight theta). "mean_weights": focal, mean weights selected analogs. "sum": Sum values across analogs (requires values). "mean": Mean values across analogs (requires values). "weighted_sum": Sum (value × weight) across analogs (requires values weight). "weighted_mean": Weighted mean values across analogs (requires values weight). "ess": Kish's effective sample size (ESS), computed squared sum weights divided sum squared weights (requires weight). "regression": Weighted least squares (ridge) regression values covariates within analog neighborhood. Returns intercept slope coefficients. Requires values, covariates, weight. See lambda regularization. character vector combining multiple stats (e.g., c("count", "weighted_mean", "regression")). Note: "none" combined stats. weight Weighting function matches, used stat includes "sum_weights" "mean_weights". One : "uniform": matches weighted equally (weight = 1.0). "inverse_clim": Inverse climate distance, weight = 1 / (climate_distance + eps), epsilon given theta. "inverse_geog": Inverse geographic distance, weight = 1 / (geographic_distance + eps), epsilon given theta. "gaussian_clim": Gaussian kernel climate distance, weight = exp(-climate_distance^2 / (2sigma^2)), sigma given theta.  "gaussian_geog": Gaussian kernel geographic distance, weight = exp(-geographic_distance^2 / (2sigma^2)), sigma given theta. "gaussian_joint": Gaussian kernel combined distance, weight = exp(-(clim_dist^2 / (2sigma_clim^2) + geog_dist^2 / (2sigma_geog^2))), sigmas given theta. "inverse_joint": Inverse joint distance, weight = 1 / (sqrt(clim_dist^2 + geog_dist^2) + eps), epsilon given theta. theta Optional numeric parameter used weighting functions stat includes "sum_weights" "mean_weights" weight "uniform". Interpretation depends weight: "inverse_clim" "inverse_geog": epsilon value added distances (scalar; default: 1e-12 climate, 1e-6 geography). "gaussian_clim" "gaussian_geog": sigma bandwidth parameter (scalar; larger values = slower decay distance). "gaussian_joint" "inverse_joint": 2-element vector c(theta_clim, theta_geog) (defaults: 1 climate, 1 geography). lambda Ridge penalty parameter stat = "regression" (default: 0, giving ordinary weighted least squares). Higher values shrink covariate coefficients toward zero, intercept approaching weighted mean lambda -> Inf. Either: positive integer. "auto" (default): Automatically tune index resolution optimizing compute time subsample focal points. focal relatively rows, auto-tuning skipped default resolution 16 used. title: Build Analog Index — build_analog_index
text: lattice index multidimensional grid bins, built geographic climate dimensions. structure enables efficient analog searches first filtering sorting bins similar points computing exact results. lon/lat coordinates, index uses ECEF (Earth-Centered Earth-Fixed) space internally optimal performance. Index resolution (index_res) controls granularity spatial binning. optimal value depends data size query patterns. Use tune_index_res() find best resolution use case, accept default 16 works well many applications.

title: Build Analog Index — build_analog_index
text: large datasets, downsampling can significantly improve memory usage query speed, cost precision. downsample parameter controls target fraction data points pool retained index. Downsampling uses adaptive stratified approach: densely-packed bins thinned aggressively sparse bins preserved, helps reduce imprecision sparse regions compared fully random sampling. Note: actual rate may higher requested maintaining least one point per occupied bin requires (common sparse data fine-grained binning); check index$downsample_actual. remaining analog downsampled pool gets sample_weight indicating number points represents original pool; weight inverse sampling rate analog's index bin. pair queries (stat = "none"), results include analog's sample_weight. aggregation stats (count, sum, mean, etc.), sampling weights used internally automatically correct downsampling bias.

text: x Focal locations analogs found. matrix/data.frame columns x, y, climate variables, SpatRaster climate variable layers. pool reference dataset search analogs. Either: Matrix/data.frame columns x, y, climate variables, SpatRaster climate variable layers, analog_index object created build_analog_index() (repeated queries). downsample Optional downsampling rate (0-1) reference pool, indicating proportion points retain. Values < 1 reduce memory improve speed cost precision. Default 1.0 (downsampling). Ignored pool pre-built index. seed Optional random seed reproducible downsampling. NULL (default), uses current R random state. Ignored pool pre-built index downsample = 1. select Character string specifying analog selection strategy. One : "" (default): Select analogs satisfy max_clim max_geog constraints. "knn_clim": focal, select k analogs smallest climate distance, subject filters. "knn_geog": focal, select k analogs smallest geographic distance, subject filters. stat Statistic(s) used aggregate selected analogs. Either: NULL "none": Return selected analog pairs data.frame. "count": focal, count number selected analogs. "sum_weights": focal, sum weights selected analogs (see weight theta). "mean_weights": focal, mean weights selected analogs. "sum": Sum values across analogs (requires values). "mean": Mean values across analogs (requires values). "weighted_sum": Sum (value × weight) across analogs (requires values weight). "weighted_mean": Weighted mean values across analogs (requires values weight). "ess": Kish's effective sample size (ESS), computed squared sum weights divided sum squared weights (requires weight). "regression": Weighted least squares (ridge) regression values covariates within analog neighborhood. Returns intercept slope coefficients. Requires values, covariates, weight. See lambda regularization. character vector combining multiple stats (e.g., c("count", "weighted_mean", "regression")). Note: "none" combined stats. max_clim Maximum climate distance constraint (default: NULL = climate constraint). Can either: scalar: Euclidean radius climate space (e.g., 0.5) vector: Per-variable absolute differences (length must equal number climate variables) reference locations within climate distance considered. x_cov provided, scalar thresholds interpreted Mahalanobis distance units. max_geog Maximum geographic distance constraint (default: NULL = geographic constraint). specified, reference locations within distance considered. Radius units specified kilometers coord_type = "lonlat", projected coordinate units coord_type = "projected". k Number nearest analogs return per focal location kNN selection modes. Required select "knn_geog" "knn_clim"; must NULL select = "". weight Weighting function matches, used stat includes "sum_weights" "mean_weights". One : "uniform": matches weighted equally (weight = 1.0). "inverse_clim": Inverse climate distance, weight = 1 / (climate_distance + eps), epsilon given theta. "inverse_geog": Inverse geographic distance, weight = 1 / (geographic_distance + eps), epsilon given theta. "gaussian_clim": Gaussian kernel climate distance, weight = exp(-climate_distance^2 / (2sigma^2)), sigma given theta.  "gaussian_geog": Gaussian kernel geographic distance, weight = exp(-geographic_distance^2 / (2sigma^2)), sigma given theta. "gaussian_joint": Gaussian kernel combined distance, weight = exp(-(clim_dist^2 / (2sigma_clim^2) + geog_dist^2 / (2sigma_geog^2))), sigmas given theta. "inverse_joint": Inverse joint distance, weight = 1 / (sqrt(clim_dist^2 + geog_dist^2) + eps), epsilon given theta. theta Optional numeric parameter used weighting functions stat includes "sum_weights" "mean_weights" weight "uniform". Interpretation depends weight: "inverse_clim" "inverse_geog": epsilon value added distances (scalar; default: 1e-12 climate, 1e-6 geography). "gaussian_clim" "gaussian_geog": sigma bandwidth parameter (scalar; larger values = slower decay distance). "gaussian_joint" "inverse_joint": 2-element vector c(theta_clim, theta_geog) (defaults: 1 climate, 1 geography). x_cov Optional focal-specific covariance matrices Mahalanobis distance calculations. matrix data.frame one row per focal location one column per unique covariance component, SpatRaster layer component. n climate variables, n*(n+1)/2 unique components, ordered : variances first (diagonals), covariances (upper triangle row). values Optional user-defined variables reference location pool aggregate across selected analogs. Can numeric vector (single variable), matrix data.frame numeric columns (multiple variables), SpatRaster one numeric layers. Must exactly number reference locations pool. provided, enables value-based aggregation stats "sum", "mean", "weighted_sum", "weighted_mean", "regression". stat = NULL/"none" (pairs mode), value columns included output analog pair. covariates Optional auxiliary predictor variables reference location pool, used stat = "regression". Can numeric vector (single covariate), matrix data.frame numeric columns (multiple covariates), SpatRaster one numeric layers. Must exactly number rows/cells pool. Column names used output layer naming. variables used analog search – local regression within analog neighborhood. lambda Ridge penalty parameter stat = "regression" (default: 0, giving ordinary weighted least squares). Higher values shrink covariate coefficients toward zero, intercept approaching weighted mean lambda -> Inf. Ignored "regression" stat. coord_type Coordinate system type: "auto" (default): Automatically detect coordinate ranges. "lonlat": Unprojected lon/lat coordinates (uses great-circle distance; assumes max_geog km). "projected": Projected XY coordinates (uses planar distance; assumes max_geog projection units). n_threads Optional integer number threads use computation. NULL (default), global RcppParallel setting used (see RcppParallel::setThreadOptions). default_res Default resolution use starting point search. Default 16. verbose Logical; TRUE, print selected resolution. Default FALSE.
